name: Sengoku
tagline: Otemachi in 12 minutes and Tokyo in 18 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Bunkyo City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 12 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 30 minutes to Shibuya and 32 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 23.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 23.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.3 m to 25.1 m, a difference of 1.8 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: Food Style 文京グリーンコート店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 東京健生病院, about 880 m away and 都立駒込病院, about 1020 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Sugamo is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities, but Sengoku is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: 811 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Sengoku.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hon-Komagome, but Sengoku is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: 918 m away in a straight line. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Sengoku. One-room rents run about ¥12,000 lower.

白山通り (3 lanes each way) runs 23 m away, right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 白山通り runs 8 m away.
